whatIs: Alyn is a directory that brings together thousands of skills for coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file that teaches the agent how to do a specific task, and each one is listed with its GitHub stars, its installs and its own score.
It's a good fit when you want to find reliable skills without combing through GitHub by hand, or see which ones the community uses most.
uses: Looking for a skill for a repetitive task, such as reviewing code or generating commits, and seeing how many people have already installed it.
Installing a skill in the right folder of your agent with the npx alyn-cli add CLI.
Publishing your own skill, from a public GitHub repository, so others can find it.
caveats: Skills belong to their authors and live in their repositories, so check each one's license before using it in a commercial project.
Review a skill's content before installing it: it gives instructions, and sometimes scripts, to your agent.
Install counters reflect only installs made with the skills CLI, so treat them as a guide rather than an exact figure.
pricingNote: All skills are open source and free to install; the MCP server doesn't require an account.
idealFor: Anyone who uses a coding agent and wants skills that others have already tested.
